subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text.
stimulus: "May I come in, Sir?" said the guardian. "Yes, come in, please," said the Headmaster. The guardian said, "We, all the guardians along with you must do something for the betterment of our children. They are losing their morality." The Headmaster said, "Let's plan something for their betterment."

subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text:
stimulus: "May I come in, Sir? said the guardian. "Yes, come in, please", said the Headmaster. The guardian said, "We, all the guardians along with you must do something for the betterment of our children. They are losing their morality." The Headmaster said, "Let's plan something for their betterment."
guide_solution: Change the narrative style: The guardian respectfully asked the Headmaster if he might come in. The Headmaster permitted him to enter. The guardian then suggested that all the guardians along with the Headmaster must do something for the betterment of their children as they were losing their morality. The Headmaster agreed to plan something for their betterment.
source: SSC English 2nd-paper Jashore Board-2025 (Board Question With Solution)
